reason: I like the idea of magnesium for sleep and stress, but I see gummies with sugar and glucose syrup and I think, that is not what I want to put into my body every day. I would have to see a real reason to trust it before I spend money on a brand I have never heard of.
objection: It has sugar and glucose syrup in it, and two a day is a lot of sugar for something that is meant to be healthy. A brand with no reviews launching now also makes me wary.
would_change_my_mind: Reviews from women my age who have used it for a few months, plus a clear sugar figure per gummy printed on the packaging.
